text: The compose attachment browser test has a next-line mozilla/no-redeclare-with-import-autofix suppression immediately before its ExtensionUtils import. The No bug patch adds only this directive, and the accepted source preserves it. The test has its own manifest/head and webextension-test globals configuration. This is a scoped source fact, not permission to suppress imports elsewhere or a diagnosis of the upstream rule. No lint or test ran.
title: Compose attachment test retains a single-import lint exception
